title: Squarespace Pricing in 2026 and What a Site Costs
summary: Squarespace pricing breaks into four tiers with bundled features and separate add-on costs. Compare each plan's price and features to decide.
body_markdown:
## Squarespace order and entry automation


Stop retyping them: let the tools pass the data along themselves, starting with what Squarespace already includes and moving to a workflow tool only if that falls short. It saves hours of admin and leaves your plan bill untouched.


**Doing nothing has a price** , just not one on an invoice. Every order copied by hand into a spreadsheet, every inquiry pasted into a customer list, is time you pay for in evenings.


### Built-in Squarespace order and form notifications


Start with what you already pay for. Squarespace can email you each order and each form submission.


> Doing nothing has a price, just not one on an invoice. Every order copied by hand into a spreadsheet, every inquiry pasted into a customer list, is time you pay for in evenings.


Forms can also be set to store their entries in a connected account, such as a Google Sheet or a Mailchimp email list, depending on the form. For a small shop, that may be the whole job done, at no extra cost.


Where it stops is simple: each connection is fixed. It sends one thing to one place, and it can't decide anything along the way.


### Automating Squarespace order and form copying


To fill that gap, you add a workflow tool. It watches for something to happen, such as a new order or a submitted form.


It then runs a short list of steps you set up once, and from then on it does the typing a person would have done.


Below, an order and a form entry sit on the left, a workflow box in the middle, and a spreadsheet, customer list and chat window on the right. The box replaces the person who used to sit between them, copying one to the other.


Activepieces can send each Squarespace order and form entry into a spreadsheet, a CRM and Slack in one flow, and its published pricing page lists that whole trip as 1 credit per flow run, whatever the number of steps.


Zapier's pricing page bills per task and Make's bills per module, so the same three-destination job counts as several units there. The free plan carries 1,000 credits a month with unlimited flows, which is room for 1,000 orders a month before anything is billed.


Check the terms before you build around one, because many of these tools charge their own fees as volume grows. But that cost sits outside your Squarespace plan, and the plan price stays where it was.
